description_en: Generates domain ownership verification DNS records for agent registration - Step 2
description_zh: 注册Agent - 步骤二：生成域名归属验证解析记录
name: CreateAtiAgentRegisterInfoAcmeChallengeRecord

parameters.help_en:
Ensures the idempotence of the request. You can generate a client token to ensure that the value is unique across different requests. The ClientToken parameter supports only ASCII characters and can be up to 64 characters in length. 

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The agent registration ID. This ID is automatically generated by the Alibaba Cloud ATS platform and is globally unique within the platform. It is generated during the agent registration process. You must include this ID in all API calls throughout the registration and query processes. To obtain the AgentRegisterInfoId, call the ListAtiAgentRegisterInfos operation to query the target agent and retrieve the ID from the response
parameters.help_zh: AgentRegisterInfoId Agent注册ID。由阿里云 ATS 平台自动生成，在阿里云 ATS 平台具有全局唯一性。在 Agent 注册过程中自动生成，通过API注册、查询流程中，该 ID 必须全程携带，需调用接口 ListAtiAgentRegisterInfos 查询目标Agent后从应答内容获取AgentRegisterInfoId
parameters.name: agent_register_info_id

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details of the access denial. This field is returned only when RAM authentication fails
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 访问被拒绝详细信息，只有RAM校验失败才会返回此字段

AuthAction.description_en: The unauthorized operation that was attempted
AuthAction.description_zh: 尝试执行的未授权操作

AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_en: The display name of the authorization principal

AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_en: The ID of the principal owner

EncodedDiagnosticMessage.description_zh: 加密后的完整诊断信息

NoPermissionType.description_en:
The cause of the authentication failure. Valid values:
ExplicitDeny: Explicitly denied.
ImplicitDeny: Implicitly denied
NoPermissionType.description_zh:
导致鉴权失败的原因。具体取值为：
ExplicitDeny：显示拒绝
ImplicitDeny：隐式拒绝

AgentRegisterInfoId.description_en: The agent registration ID. This ID is automatically generated by the Alibaba Cloud ATS platform and is globally unique within the platform. It is generated during the agent registration process. You must include this ID in all API calls throughout the multi-step registration process to ensure that all steps are associated with the same agent and to complete the registration
AgentRegisterInfoId.description_zh: AgentRegisterInfoId Agent注册ID。由阿里云 ATS 平台自动生成，在阿里云 ATS 平台具有全局唯一性。在 Agent 注册过程中自动生成，通过API注册的多步流程中，该 ID 必须全程携带，以确保各步骤关联至同一 Agent，完成完整的注册闭环

ExpireTimestamp.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the instance expires

RecordName.description_en: The host record of the DNS record for domain ownership verification
RecordName.description_zh: 域名归属验证解析记录的主机记录

RecordType.description_en: The type of the DNS record for domain ownership verification. Typically, the value is TXT
RecordType.description_zh: 域名归属验证解析记录类型，一般为TXT

RecordValue.description_en: The value of the DNS record for domain ownership verification
RecordValue.description_zh: 域名归属验证解析记录的记录值
